'''Reese''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
Reese was at [[Nym's Base]] when it was [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|attacked]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. When [[Evac 1]] had engine relay problem, Reese was the one to fix the relay, enabling the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to take off from the besieged base. Unfortunately for Reese, Evac 1 barely made it to the edge of the base before being bombed and destroyed by [[Trade Federation droid bomber]]s.
